summary: Unpinned third-party github: dependency resolves and executes attacker-mutable code at install time
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity check. On `npm install`, npm resolves this source to whatever is currently at the default branch of that third-party GitHub repository and runs any lifecycle scripts it ships. The repository owner `tenka-san` is not the publisher of this npm package (`itsmeeaizat1`), so a party unrelated to the npm publisher controls code that executes on every installer. Any future commit to that repository's default branch is delivered to installers without any version pin, review, or hash verification.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
